reference_answer: We compare the lengths of successive observation periods. Specifically, a systematic procedure records every exclusion and its reason. These concrete observations clarify the operational scope of the method without overstating its generality.
acceptable_alternatives: Rather than relying on unverified claims, the analysis specifies concrete procedures: We compare the lengths of successive observation periods. Meanwhile, a systematic procedure records every exclusion and its reason.
explanation_zh:
本题考查【根治只有夸张而无实例/指标的写作病灶（Rule G033/G028）】。
地道学术写作从不说 *extremely great / solves all problems*，而是用具体操作与边界说话：
- 第 1 句用“successive”（We compare the lengths of successive observation periods.）给出具体研究事实或操作定义；
- 第 2 句用“systematic”（A systematic procedure records every exclusion and its reason.）补充具体测量、分布或样本条件；
- 第 3 句收束于受控范围，实现“主张—具体机制—实证边界”的严密闭环。

3. 零 AI 痕迹：直接交代操作、约束与评估范围，文风贴近 NeurIPS/ICLR 顶会标准。注意：参考答案并非唯一正确表达。
